item.proyectox.nucleo_xeranio.desc: Unstable energy crystal from Sector 9. Powers the whole arsenal.
item.proyectox.martinete.uso1: Left click: an 8-damage blow (0.9 blows per second). If you hit a creature while falling from more than 3 blocks, the blow deals 25 damage and opens a 4-block earthquake that paralyses every creature around for 3 s and, while it lasts, shakes them every second for 2 damage.
item.proyectox.martinete.uso2: The earthquake's shockwave cushions your fall with a little hop: you take no damage. It never knocks back.
item.proyectox.aguja.energia: Xeranium battery: 12 shots; recharges 1 every 0.75 s.
item.proyectox.aguja.uso1: Hold left click to charge (1.5 s) and release: a sky-blue laser with a 256-block range that goes through walls and every enemy. 20 damage uncharged, 50 fully charged.
item.proyectox.aguja.uso2: Right click: aim through the scope. 0.8 s between shots.
item.proyectox.avispon.energia: Plasma chamber: 200 pulses; refills in 10 s without firing.
item.proyectox.avispon.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire (10 pulses per second). Each pulse deals 3 to 8 damage: the longer you fire, the hotter it gets and the more damage it deals.
item.proyectox.avispon.uso2: Above half heat the pulses turn red: they deal 8 damage and set the enemy on fire. It never jams. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.colmena.energia: Nanofactory: 36 micro-rockets; builds 1 every 0.2 s while not firing.
item.proyectox.colmena.uso1: Hold left click to lock up to 6 targets near the crosshair and release: a salvo of guided micro-rockets (20 damage each).
item.proyectox.colmena.uso2: Rockets without a target follow wherever you aim. 1.2 s between salvos. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.vortice.uso1: Left click: a singularity that flies up to 260 blocks. When it touches a creature it bursts (20 damage, radius 4).
item.proyectox.vortice.uso2: Against a block it opens a 2 s vortex that pulls creatures in and then collapses (20 damage). It never pulls you. Right click: aim.
death.attack.proyectox.plasma.player: %1$s was riddled with plasma while fleeing %2$s
item.proyectox.cizalla.uso1: Left click: a 10-damage thrust (1.8 per second), with no knockback.
item.proyectox.cizalla.uso2: Right click: a crescent slash that goes through every enemy it meets (8 damage).
item.proyectox.taladro.uso1: Hold left click on a creature: the chuck spins and the bit drills into it. The longer you hold, the more damage: 3 → 10 (at 1.5 s) → 50 (at 3 s), five times per second.
item.proyectox.taladro.uso2: On blocks it digs like a netherite pickaxe and shovel at once (+1 block of reach).
item.proyectox.serpentina.energia: Superconducting coil: the rope recharges in 0.8 s.
item.proyectox.serpentina.uso1: Left click: 6-damage lash with 3 extra blocks of reach.
item.proyectox.serpentina.uso2: Right click: a 24-block blue rope that catches an enemy and drags it to you; your next hit on it deals 18 damage.
item.proyectox.chispa.energia: Capacitor: 300 charges (30 s of lightning); recharges in 15 s.
item.proyectox.chispa.uso1: Hold left click: continuous lightning (40 blocks) that shocks the enemy in your sights and jumps to 3 nearby enemies.
item.proyectox.chispa.uso2: 7 damage to each of them, five times per second. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.remache.uso1: Left click: 9 rivets that deal 28 damage within 7 blocks if they all hit. Farther away they slowly lose power, down to a quarter at 32 blocks or more (96-block range).
item.proyectox.trituradora.uso1: Left click: a grenade that bounces twice and explodes (30 damage, radius 4), releasing 4 bomblets of 10 damage.
item.proyectox.trituradora.uso2: It never hurts you or knocks anyone back. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.rotor.energia: Energy belt: 500 shots; recharges 20 per second while not firing.
item.proyectox.rotor.uso1: Hold left click: 20 tracers per second, 2 damage each, with no spin-up and without slowing you down.
item.proyectox.halcon.uso1: Left click: launches a combat drone that hunts enemies within 32 blocks for 40 s (12 damage per pulse).
item.proyectox.halcon.uso2: Up to 3 drones at once; a new one replaces the oldest. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.trueno.energia: Laser cell: 400 charges (20 s of laser); recharges in 20 s.
item.proyectox.trueno.uso1: Hold left click: a continuous 64-block laser that goes through 3 creatures and hits five times per second. It starts sky blue: 1 damage during the first second.
item.proyectox.trueno.uso2: The longer it stays on, the hotter it gets and the more damage it deals: 5 from second 1, 20 from second 2 and, after 3 s, red: 75. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.soplete.energia: Gel tank: 300 units (15 s of flame); refills in 15 s.
item.proyectox.soplete.uso1: Hold left click: a 20-block jet of fire, opaque and clearly visible by day and by night, dealing 3 damage ten times per second and setting targets on fire for 6 s.
item.proyectox.soplete.uso2: It burns fire-immune creatures too. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.escarcha.energia: Cryo tank: 300 lasers; refills in 15 s.
item.proyectox.escarcha.uso1: Hold left click: an automatic burst of small ice lasers (10 per second, 4 damage to any creature).
item.proyectox.escarcha.uso2: Every hit slows the enemy a little more until it cannot move. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.eco.uso1: Left click: a shockwave that travels 64 blocks through walls and creatures while it widens.
item.proyectox.eco.uso2: It deals 6 area damage (ignoring armour) to everything it reaches. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.bastion.energia: Field projector: 120 rounds; recharges in 12 s.
item.proyectox.bastion.uso1: Hold right click to take cover: it blocks damage from any direction (sides and back too).
item.proyectox.bastion.uso2: Left click: 8-damage kinetic rounds (5 per second), even while you take cover.
item.proyectox.colibri.energia: Needle magazine: 240 needles; regenerates 20 per second while not firing.
item.proyectox.colibri.uso1: Hold left click: 20 crystal needles per second, 6 damage each.
item.proyectox.sierra.uso1: Left click: a 10-damage saw disc that goes through every enemy and bounces up to 4 times.
item.proyectox.sierra.uso2: It never cuts you. Right click: aim.
death.attack.proyectox.dron.player: %1$s was shot down by a drone while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.proyectox.cinetico: %1$s was hit back with their own force by %2$s
item.proyectox.centella.energia: Plasma drum: 36 shots; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.centella.uso1: Left click: a 10-damage heavy plasma slug that flies 170 blocks. Every click fires (up to 5 per second); holding the button, 2.5 per second.
item.proyectox.arpon.energia: Harpoon forge: 10 harpoons; makes 1 every 0.8 s.
item.proyectox.arpon.uso1: Left click: a harpoon that sticks into the creature or the wall (18 damage) and explodes one second later: 10 damage, radius 3.5.
item.proyectox.arpon.uso2: It never hurts you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.mortero.uso1: Left click: a shell on a high arc that lands exactly where the crosshair points (up to 120 blocks): 35 damage, radius 5.
item.proyectox.mortero.uso2: Great for hitting enemies behind walls. It never hurts you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.prisma.energia: Focus crystal: 30 shots; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.prisma.uso1: Left click: a light beam that splits at 2.5 blocks into a fan of 5 coloured rays (64 blocks, 8 damage each; each ray goes through 2 creatures).
item.proyectox.prisma.uso2: If the creature is close, all five rays hit it together: 24 damage (never more than 24 per shot). Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.enjambre.uso1: Left click: a pod that, on impact, releases a nanobot swarm that chases the nearest creature for 5 s.
item.proyectox.enjambre.uso2: The swarm deals 1 damage every 0.25 s to everything it reaches and never attacks you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.caustica.energia: Acid tank: 120 globs; refills in 12 s without firing.
item.proyectox.caustica.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire of acid globules (almost 7 per second); 4 damage, splashing 2 onto those nearby.
item.proyectox.caustica.uso2: They leave a puddle on the ground that deals 2 damage every 0.5 s for 4 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.solar.uso1: Hold left click to ignite the reactor (2 s) and release: a miniature sun that explodes on impact. Uncharged, 20 damage in radius 3; fully charged, 60 in radius 6.
item.proyectox.solar.uso2: It never hurts you. 1 s between shots. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.tempestad.uso1: Left click: forms a storm cloud over the point you aim at (up to 96 blocks); for 4 s it strikes the creatures below it with 4-damage lightning.
item.proyectox.tempestad.uso2: The lightning never burns or breaks anything and never hits you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.esquirla.energia: Crystal magazine: 24 crystals; grows 1 every 0.4 s.
item.proyectox.esquirla.uso1: Left click: a 10-damage crystal that shatters into 7 shards of 8: if it goes through a creature they keep flying forward in a fan; if it hits a wall, they bounce back.
item.proyectox.ciclon.uso1: Left click: a tornado that travels along the ground for 3 s (about 21 blocks); it pulls in nearby creatures and grinds the ones it catches (2 damage every 0.25 s).
item.proyectox.ciclon.uso2: It never pulls you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.minador.uso1: Left click: a mine that sticks to any surface, arms in 0.6 s and explodes when a creature comes close: 30 damage, radius 4.
item.proyectox.minador.uso2: If it touches a creature it explodes at once. Up to 8 mines: placing another detonates the oldest. They last 60 s and never hurt you.
item.proyectox.ceniza.uso1: Left click: a slow green disintegrator ring that goes through every creature it meets (7 damage to each) along 70 blocks. It ignores shields and armour.
item.proyectox.ceniza.uso2: It stops when it hits a block. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.saeta.uso1: Hold left click to draw the light string (1 s) and release: a light arrow that goes through up to 3 creatures. From 10 damage undrawn to 25 fully drawn.
item.proyectox.saeta.uso2: Fully drawn, the arrow flies faster and straighter. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.guadana.uso1: Left click: a 150°, 4.5-block sweep that hits every creature in front of you (9 damage).
item.proyectox.guadana.uso2: Holding the button, one sweep every 0.6 s. It does not go through walls and never knocks back.
item.proyectox.pica.uso1: Left click: a 7-block plasma thrust that goes through every creature in line (10 damage).
item.proyectox.pica.uso2: Holding the button, one thrust every 0.5 s. It never knocks back.

item.proyectox.yunque.energia: Energy magazine: 28 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.yunque.uso1: Left click: an 8-damage heavy-calibre round with a 200-block range. Every click fires (up to 5 per second); holding the button, about 3 per second.
item.proyectox.yunque.uso2: Perfectly accurate while aiming. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.chacal.energia: Energy magazine: 120 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.chacal.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire, 10 rounds per second, 7 damage each, 200-block range.
item.proyectox.chacal.uso2: Aiming greatly reduces the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.trabuco.uso1: Left click: 8 pellets of 3.5 damage; at point-blank range they all hit (28 damage). 64-block range; one shot every 0.75 s.
item.proyectox.trabuco.uso2: The closer you are, the more pellets hit. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.coyote.energia: Energy drum: 36 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.coyote.uso1: Left click: a 7-damage round with a 220-block range. Every click fires (up to 4 per second); holding the button, almost 3 per second.
item.proyectox.coyote.uso2: Perfectly accurate while aiming. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.granizo.energia: Energy belt: 400 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.granizo.uso1: Hold left click: 20 rounds per second, 2 damage each, 200-block range.
item.proyectox.granizo.uso2: Aiming reduces the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.lince.energia: Energy magazine: 12 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.75 s.
item.proyectox.lince.uso1: Left click: a 20-damage round with a 320-block range; one shot every 1.2 s (bolt action).
item.proyectox.lince.uso2: Right click: look through the scope (sniper zoom and perfect accuracy).
item.proyectox.rugido.energia: Loading tube: 6 rockets; loads 1 every 1.5 s.
item.proyectox.rugido.uso1: Left click: a rocket that flies straight for 216 blocks and explodes on impact: 40 damage, radius 4.5 (the direct target takes full damage).
item.proyectox.rugido.uso2: One rocket every 1.5 s. It never hurts you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.meteoro.uso1: Left click: marks the crosshair point (up to 128 blocks) and one second later a meteor falls right there: 45 damage, radius 6.
item.proyectox.meteoro.uso2: Under a roof, the meteor appears below the ceiling. It never hurts you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.pulsar.uso1: Left click: a slow energy sphere that passes through creatures: each one it touches takes 6 damage and is paralysed for 1 s. Every 0.5 s it also zaps the 3 nearest enemies (6 blocks) with the same effect.
item.proyectox.pulsar.uso2: When it hits a block, or after 5 s, it explodes: 10 damage in radius 4 and 3 s of paralysis to everything around. It never hurts you. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.falla.uso1: Left click: a ground slam that opens a 29-block fissure in the direction you are looking; the rock spikes deal 22 damage to every creature they reach.
item.proyectox.falla.uso2: The fissure follows the terrain and climbs steps; it stops at a wall or a cliff. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.centinela.uso1: Left click: places a turret where you aim (up to 12 blocks) that for 20 s fires 4 rounds per second, 5 damage each, at enemies it can see within 24 blocks.
item.proyectox.centinela.uso2: It attacks monsters and anyone fighting you, never you. Up to 2 at once: a third one replaces the oldest.
item.proyectox.retorno.uso1: Left click: a chakram that flies 32 blocks slicing every creature it crosses (11 damage) and comes back to your hand slicing again (11).
item.proyectox.retorno.uso2: If it hits a wall it comes back early; on the way back it passes through blocks. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.marea.energia: Pressure tank: 300 units; refills by itself.
item.proyectox.marea.uso1: Hold left click: a 26-block pressurised water jet dealing 2 damage 10 times per second to every creature it touches.
item.proyectox.marea.uso2: With a full tank the jet lasts 15 s of continuous fire. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.mangual.uso1: Left click: you whirl the ball around you: 8 damage to every creature within 3.6 blocks, all 360°.
item.proyectox.mangual.uso2: Holding the button, one spin every 0.3 s. It does not go through walls and never knocks back.
item.proyectox.ariete.uso1: Left click: a punch that releases a shockwave in a 60°, 5-block cone: 12 damage to every creature it reaches.
item.proyectox.ariete.uso2: Holding the button, one punch every 0.75 s. It does not go through walls and never knocks back.

death.attack.proyectox.hidro.player: %1$s was blasted away by water while fleeing %2$s
item.proyectox.bisonte.energia: Energy cylinder: 30 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.bisonte.uso1: Left click: a 12-damage magnum round with a 220-block range. Every click fires (over 3 per second); holding the button, about 2 per second.
item.proyectox.bisonte.uso2: Aiming looks through the rear and front sights: perfect accuracy. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.vibora.energia: Energy cylinder: 35 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.25 s.
item.proyectox.vibora.uso1: Left click: a 9-damage round with a 200-block range. Every click fires (up to 4 per second); holding the button, almost 3 per second.
item.proyectox.vibora.uso2: Aiming looks through the red dot sight: perfect accuracy. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.tejon.energia: Energy magazine: 45 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.2 s.
item.proyectox.tejon.uso1: Left click: a 7-damage round with a 160-block range. Every click fires (almost 7 per second); holding the button, 4 per second.
item.proyectox.tejon.uso2: Aiming looks through the rear and front sights: almost no spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.sombra.energia: Energy magazine: 51 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.2 s.
item.proyectox.sombra.uso1: Left click: an 8-damage round with a 180-block range. Every click fires (up to 5 per second); holding the button, over 3 per second.
item.proyectox.sombra.uso2: The suppressor hides the muzzle flash and the shot is barely heard 16 blocks away. Perfectly accurate while aiming. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.galgo.energia: Energy magazine: 60 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.15 s.
item.proyectox.galgo.uso1: Left click: an 8-damage round with a 200-block range. Every click fires (almost 7 per second); holding the button, 5 per second.
item.proyectox.galgo.uso2: The compensator keeps the muzzle down. Aiming through the red dot sight, perfect accuracy. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.azor.energia: Energy magazine: 120 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.azor.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire, 12 rounds per second, 8 damage each, 220-block range.
item.proyectox.azor.uso2: Aiming through the holographic sight almost removes the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.condor.energia: Energy magazine: 40 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.3 s.
item.proyectox.condor.uso1: Left click: a 15-damage round with a 280-block range. Every click fires (up to 4 per second); holding the button, over 3 per second.
item.proyectox.condor.uso2: Right click: look through the scope (magnification and perfect accuracy).
item.proyectox.huron.energia: Energy magazine: 150 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.huron.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire, 15 rounds per second, 5 damage each, 160-block range.
item.proyectox.huron.uso2: Aiming through the red dot sight greatly reduces the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.buho.energia: Energy magazine: 120 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.buho.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire, 13 rounds per second, 6 damage each, 180-block range.
item.proyectox.buho.uso2: The integral suppressor hides the muzzle flash and almost all the noise. Aiming greatly reduces the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.pirana.energia: Energy magazine: 200 rounds; refills by itself (20 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.pirana.uso1: Hold left click: automatic fire, 20 rounds per second, 4 damage each, 140-block range.
item.proyectox.pirana.uso2: Aiming reduces the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.jabali.energia: Energy magazine: 32 shells; loads 1 every 0.4 s.
item.proyectox.jabali.uso1: Left click: 8 pellets of 3.5 damage; at point-blank range they all hit (28 damage). 64-block range; every click fires (over 3 per second).
item.proyectox.jabali.uso2: The closer you are, the more pellets hit. Aiming through the ghost ring sight tightens the cone. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.avalancha.energia: Energy drum: 40 shells; loads 1 every 0.3 s.
item.proyectox.avalancha.uso1: Hold left click: 4 shots per second of 8 pellets, 3 damage each (24 at point-blank range). 56-block range.
item.proyectox.avalancha.uso2: The closer you are, the more pellets hit. Aiming tightens the cone. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.diluvio.energia: Energy belt: 800 rounds; refills by itself (40 per second) half a second after you stop firing.
item.proyectox.diluvio.uso1: Hold left click: 40 rounds per second, 4 damage each, 200-block range.
item.proyectox.diluvio.uso2: Aiming halves the spread. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.volcan.energia: Energy cylinder: 12 grenades; loads 1 per second.
item.proyectox.volcan.uso1: Left click: a 40 mm grenade that flies in an arc and explodes on impact: 30 damage, radius 4 (the direct target takes full damage).
item.proyectox.volcan.uso2: Every click fires (up to 2 per second). It never hurts you or breaks blocks. Right click: aim with the reflex sight.
item.proyectox.mamut.energia: Energy magazine: 10 rounds; recharges 1 per second.
item.proyectox.mamut.uso1: Left click: a 40-damage heavy-calibre round with a 400-block range; one shot every 1.5 s (bolt action).
item.proyectox.mamut.uso2: Right click: look through the scope (maximum magnification and perfect accuracy).

item.proyectox.pixel.energia: Neon battery: 40 pulses; recharges 1 every 0.15 s.
item.proyectox.pixel.uso1: Left click: an 8-damage magenta laser pulse that flies 128 blocks. Every click fires (up to 5 per second); holding the button, just over 3 per second.
item.proyectox.pixel.uso2: Perfectly accurate while aiming. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.voltio.uso1: Hold left click: 12 electric pulses per second, 5 damage each.
item.proyectox.voltio.uso2: Every pulse that hits arcs to another nearby creature (4.5 blocks) for 2. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.estatica.uso1: Left click: 8 static discharges of 3.5 damage in a spread (24-block range). One every 0.7 s.
item.proyectox.estatica.uso2: Up close almost all of them hit: 28 damage. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.diodo.uso1: Hold left click to charge (1 s) and release: a 96-block beam of light that goes through every creature. 12 damage uncharged, 30 fully charged.
item.proyectox.diodo.uso2: The beam stops at blocks. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.fusible.uso1: Left click: an EMP grenade that bounces and goes off after 1.2 s (or when it touches a creature): 10 damage within 4 blocks.
item.proyectox.fusible.uso2: Everything caught is paralysed for 2 s: it cannot move or attack. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.antena.uso1: Left click: a 22-damage ray with a 200-block range that goes through 2 creatures (hits up to 3). One every 1.2 s.
item.proyectox.antena.uso2: Aiming looks through the telescopic sight. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.vinilo.uso1: Left click: a sharpened 9-damage vinyl disc that cuts every creature it touches and bounces off walls up to 4 times.
item.proyectox.vinilo.uso2: Every click throws one (up to 2.5 per second). Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.bajo.uso1: Left click: a bass wave in a 40°, 10-block cone that goes through walls and deals 12 damage to every creature.
item.proyectox.bajo.uso2: One every 0.8 s; ignores armour. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.nexo.energia: Hangar: 30 energy (3 per volley); recharges 1 every 0.3 s.
item.proyectox.nexo.uso1: Left click: releases three mini-drones that hunt nearby enemies and blow up on contact: 8 damage within 1.5 blocks.
item.proyectox.nexo.uso2: One volley every 1.5 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.neon.energia: Blade of light: uses no energy.
item.proyectox.neon.uso1: Left click: a 120°, 3.6-block sweep that hits every creature in front of you (10 damage).
item.proyectox.neon.uso2: Holding the button, one sweep every 0.5 s. It does not go through walls.
item.proyectox.rele.uso1: Left click: a 9-damage blow to the creature in front of you (up to 3.8 blocks) that paralyses it for 1 s.
item.proyectox.rele.uso2: Holding the button, one blow every 0.7 s.
item.proyectox.frecuencia.uso1: Hold left click: a 40-block wave beam dealing 3 damage ten times per second that goes through 2 creatures.
item.proyectox.frecuencia.uso2: Uses 10 energy per second. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.tuberia.uso1: Left click: a 14-damage bullet with a 120-block range. One every 0.7 s.
item.proyectox.tuberia.uso2: Real gunpowder: muzzle flash and smoke. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.chapa.uso1: Left click: 9 pellets of 3 damage (32-block range). One every 0.9 s.
item.proyectox.chapa.uso2: Up close almost all of them hit: 27 damage. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.clavo.uso1: Hold left click: 10 nails per second, 4 damage each.
item.proyectox.clavo.uso2: Nails drop a little over distance. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.serrucho.uso1: Left click: an 11-damage saw blade that cuts every creature it touches and bounces 3 times.
item.proyectox.serrucho.uso2: One every 0.6 s; the blade drops a little. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.perno.uso1: Hold left click to draw (1.2 s) and release: a rebar bolt dealing 10 damage undrawn and 28 fully drawn that goes through 2 creatures.
item.proyectox.perno.uso2: Fully drawn, it flies faster and flatter. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.molotov.uso1: Left click: throws a Molotov cocktail (6 damage on a direct hit) that bursts into a 2.5-block pool of fire for 4 s.
item.proyectox.molotov.uso2: The fire deals 3 damage every 0.5 s and sets whatever steps in it ablaze for 4 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.bidon.uso1: Left click: fires a canister that blows up on impact: 24 damage within 4.5 blocks.
item.proyectox.bidon.uso2: It flies in an arc: aim slightly above. One every 1.5 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.cacharro.energia: Hopper: 16 pieces of junk; recharges 1 every 0.6 s.
item.proyectox.cacharro.uso1: Left click: spits out a 12-damage chunk of junk that bounces 3 times off walls and creatures.
item.proyectox.cacharro.uso2: Every bounce can hit another creature. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.manivela.energia: Ammo can: 300 rounds; recharges 1 every 0.05 s.
item.proyectox.manivela.uso1: Hold left click: 15 rounds per second, 4 damage each (120-block range).
item.proyectox.manivela.uso2: It spreads a lot: best at medium range. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.garfio.uso1: Left click: fires the hook (about 45 blocks). If it hooks a creature it deals 8 damage and drags it towards you.
item.proyectox.garfio.uso2: If it hooks a block, the cable flings you to it (no fall damage when you land). Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.palanca.uso1: Left click: a 14-damage blow to the creature in front of you (up to 4 blocks) and a 7-damage shockwave around it (2.5 blocks).
item.proyectox.palanca.uso2: Hitting the ground also raises the shockwave. One blow every 0.9 s.
item.proyectox.oxido.uso1: Left click: a 100°, 3-block sweep that hits every creature in front of you (9 damage).
item.proyectox.oxido.uso2: Holding the button, one sweep every 0.45 s.
item.proyectox.espora.uso1: Hold left click: 4 spores per second that seek out their prey (7 damage).
item.proyectox.espora.uso2: Every spore poisons for 2 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.glifo.uso1: Left click: an 11-damage glyph ray with an 80-block range that goes through 3 creatures.
item.proyectox.glifo.uso2: One every 0.4 s; ignores armour. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.abismo.uso1: Left click: a black sphere that opens a 5-block gravity well for 3 s when it hits.
item.proyectox.abismo.uso2: The well pulls creatures in and deals 2 damage every 0.25 s (ignores armour). Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.larva.energia: Comb: 24 energy (4 per brood); recharges 1 every 0.3 s.
item.proyectox.larva.uso1: Left click: releases 4 larvae that hop along the ground towards their prey (5 damage each).
item.proyectox.larva.uso2: Each larva hops up to 8 times looking for something to bite. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.eclipse.uso1: Hold left click: a 48-block beam that goes through every creature, dealing 4 damage ten times per second.
item.proyectox.eclipse.uso2: Ignores armour. Uses 10 energy per second. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.nebula.uso1: Left click: a slow nebula orb dealing 3 damage every 0.25 s and slowing everything that passes near it (2.5 blocks).
item.proyectox.nebula.uso2: When it hits or fades it leaves a 3-block cloud for 4 s: 2 damage every 0.5 s and slowness. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.simbionte.energia: It feeds on what it cuts: uses no energy.
item.proyectox.simbionte.uso1: Left click: a 140°, 3.8-block sweep that hits every creature in front of you (11 damage, ignores armour).
item.proyectox.simbionte.uso2: Heals you half a heart for every creature hit. One sweep every 0.6 s.
item.proyectox.eter.uso1: Left click: a 30°, 12-block cone that deals 6 damage and makes the creatures you can see levitate for 1.5 s.
item.proyectox.eter.uso2: One every 0.8 s. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.cenit.uso1: Hold left click to draw (1 s) and release: three arrows of light that seek their prey. 6 damage each undrawn, 16 fully drawn.
item.proyectox.cenit.uso2: The arrows turn by themselves towards enemies ahead. Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.umbral.uso1: Left click: opens a rift where you aim (up to 32 blocks) for 3 s.
item.proyectox.umbral.uso2: The rift pulls in everything within 6 blocks and deals 3 damage every 0.25 s to whatever is within 3 (ignores armour). Right click: aim.
item.proyectox.observador.uso1: Left click: summons an eye that floats for 15 s where you look and fires a 5-damage ray every 0.5 s at the enemies it sees (up to 20 blocks).
item.proyectox.observador.uso2: At most 2 eyes at once: summoning another closes the oldest. It only attacks monsters and whoever fights you.
item.proyectox.aguijon.uso1: Left click: a 6-block thrust that goes through every creature in line (12 damage).
item.proyectox.aguijon.uso2: Poisons for 2 s. Holding the button, one thrust every 0.6 s.
